ctaHeading: Visit Origin Trade in Ravenhall today.
aboutText: Origin Trade is Ravenhall's go-to destination for tiles, flooring, sanitary ware, and home decoration. Located on Robinsons Road, we stock a massive range of floor tiles, wall tiles, and modern finishes to suit every style and budget. Our team knows tiles inside and out, helping homeowners, builders, and trades across Melbourne's west find exactly what they need. From classic ceramics to trending large-format porcelain, we make choosing your next surface simple.
servicesSubheading: Tiles, flooring & more under one roof
servicesText: From floor and wall tiles to full bathroom fitouts and smart home tech, Origin Trade carries everything you need for your next build or renovation. We supply to DIYers and trade professionals alike.

services.title: Floor & Wall Tiles
services.desc: Huge range of ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas throughout Ravenhall homes.

services.title: Flooring Solutions

services.title: Sanitary Ware

services.title: Home Decoration
services.desc: Feature tiles, mosaic borders, and decorative elements to add character and style to any room.

services.title: Doors & Hardware
services.desc: Internal doors, door handles, hinges, and hardware to finish off your project with quality fittings.

reviews.text: Brought our builder to Origin Trade in Ravenhall for bathroom tiles. Huge selection, great prices, and the staff helped us pick the perfect porcelain for our ensuite. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: As a local plumber I regularly recommend Origin Trade to my clients. Their sanitary ware range is solid, and the Smart Switch products are a great upsell for bathroom renos.

reviews.text: We fitted out a whole apartment complex with tiles and flooring from Origin Trade. Professional service, competitive trade pricing, and they always have stock ready to go.
